content.title: How to watch UCF vs. UCLA men’s basketball: First Round TV channel and streaming options for March 20
content.text: The No. 7 UCLA Bruins (23-11) and the No. 10 UCF Knights (21-11) square off on Friday for a place in the second round of the NCAA Tournament.
